parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The drag force $F_{\mathrm{D}}$ acting on a sphere moving through a fluid is given by the expression $F_{\mathrm{D}}$ = K$\rho$v ^{2}
where K is a constant, $\rho$ is the density of the fluid and v is the speed of the sphere.
Determine the SI base units of K.
base units

markscheme_points.text: units of F: kg m s-2
units of ρ: kg m-3 and units of v: m s-1
units of K: kg m s-2 / [kg m-3 (m s-1)2] = m2

hints: Hint 1: Identify the given data from the problem and recall the governing equation connecting these quantities using density formula.

Hint 3: Check your intermediate calculation steps carefully and ensure your final answer is stated to an appropriate number of significant figures with correct SI units.
